use_cases: Primary app navigation with visual feedback for active state
Tab switching interface with spotlight effect for contextual highlighting
Mobile-friendly bottom navigation bar with adjacent item glow
ai_summary: A dark-themed navigation bar component featuring a dynamic spotlight effect that illuminates the active tab and fades to adjacent navigation items. Uses glass-morphism styling with backdrop blur and smooth CSS transitions. The spotlight opacity calculation creates a cascading glow effect based on distance from the selected item, making it visually distinctive for app navigation.
